bot.welcome:
Welcome to RiddleVerse, {name}!

Play free puzzles right here in Telegram, challenge your friends and climb the leaderboard.
bot.welcome_group: RiddleVerse is here! Tap a game to play together. Scores are shared in this chat.
bot.help:
RiddleVerse bot commands

/daily - today's puzzle
/play - pick a game
/leaderboard - scores in this chat
/link - connect the RiddleVerse app
/remind - daily puzzle reminder on or off
/language - change language
/app - get the Android app
/help - this message
bot.daily_body: Today's game is {game}. Same puzzle for everyone, new one at midnight UTC. Solve it, then share your result.
bot.game_unknown: I do not know that game. Pick one from the list:
bot.leaderboard_empty: No scores yet. Be the first to play!
bot.leaderboard_pick: Pick a game to see its leaderboard in this chat:
bot.share_text: I scored {score} in {game} on RiddleVerse. Can you beat it?
bot.link_intro: Tap the button to connect this Telegram account to the RiddleVerse app. The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. Do not forward it.
bot.link_private_only: Please message me in a private chat to connect your app account.
bot.link_error: I could not create a link right now. Please try again in a minute.
bot.link_done: Your Telegram account is connected to RiddleVerse.
bot.remind_on: Daily puzzle reminders are on. Send /remind again to turn them off.
bot.remind_off: Daily puzzle reminders are off. Send /remind to turn them on.
bot.remind_private_only: Reminders are sent in private chats. Message me directly to turn them on.
bot.reminder_text: Today's RiddleVerse puzzle is ready: {game}. Keep your streak going!
bot.create_pointer: Creating your own games works in the RiddleVerse app. Open it there, then share the game here.
bot.unknown_command: I did not get that. Try /help.
bot.rate_limited: Slow down a little and try again in a moment.
bot.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
bot.app_text: RiddleVerse is free on Android: 23 puzzle games, a daily puzzle and streaks.
bot.bot_short_description: Free puzzle games in Telegram: daily puzzle, group leaderboards, play with friends.
bot.bot_description: RiddleVerse brings 23 free puzzle games to Telegram. Play the daily puzzle, challenge friends in a chat and climb the group leaderboard. Connect the free Android app to use one account everywhere.

web.footer_note: RiddleVerse puzzles are free to play in your browser. No account needed.
web.telegram_blurb: Play with friends in a Telegram chat: daily puzzle, group leaderboards, no install.
web.share_message: I just played {game} on RiddleVerse. Can you beat me?
